core_obligations: (1) implies (2): the limit description gives quasi-compactness, and distinct points are separated at some finite stage, which also shows total disconnectedness (proof lines 4362-4369)

(2) implies (1): form the inverse system of finite disjoint union decompositions of the space into clopen pieces, ordered by refinement, and build the canonical map into its limit (proof lines 4370-4388)

The canonical map is a homeomorphism: injectivity comes from the clopen-neighbourhood description of connected components, surjectivity from the finite intersection criterion, and the conclusion from the bijective-map statement; directedness of the index set gives the final assertion (proof lines 4389-4395)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：取有限离散 X_i 的图，X = lim X_i；由「逆极限准紧」得准紧；两点在某阶段已分开 ⇒ Hausdorff 与完全不连通。
(2)⇒(1)：取所有「X 分解为非空开闭子集的有限并」构成的指标集 I，按细化排序得有限离散空间的逆系统与连续映射 X → lim I。
该映射是双射（单射由 connected-component-intersection-compact-Hausdorff、满射由有限交判据），再由「紧 Hausdorff 间双射是同胚」收尾；I 有向给出末句。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes profinite spaces as Hausdorff quasi-compact totally disconnected spaces and adds that such a space is a cofiltered limit of finite discrete spaces (author lemma at source lines 4350-4360, label lemma-profinite). The proof (source lines 4362-4396) proves quasi-compactness, Hausdorffness and total disconnectedness from a limit description, and conversely builds the inverse system of finite clopen decompositions and shows that the canonical map into its limit is bijective and hence a homeomorphism (proof lines 4362-4395). The construction of the system of decompositions and the bijectivity argument are the substance. H3.
